messages:
samir: Heads-up from enterprise calls: customers want per-route token breakdown and reliable error->trace linking. They said an interim CSV + a trace-link with >90% success is acceptable to unblock. Proposing a narrow launch slice: cost snapshot + CSV export + trace-link + webhook alerts alpha.

gina: sounds right. can we make the trace-link deterministic by including trace_id in metrics at emit? that avoids heavy retention for GA.

yvette: yes—emit trace_id with metrics envelope. sampling default 0.5% but tenant override for Dedicated. we'll need a tiny index to look up trace URL from trace_id.

tom_k: rough engineering estimates: trace_id plumbing + lookup index: 1.5 dev-wk, UI card + CSV + webhook alpha: 1 dev-wk, infra indexing + feature flag/killswitch: 4 infra-days. total ~3.5 dev-wk across 2 squads.

samir: proposed acceptance gates: 1) accuracy: cost snapshot within 5% vs billing for top-20 tenants over 7d; 2) trace-link: resolves to correct trace >=92% of sampled traces; 3) perf: dashboard summary <600ms p95; 4) rollout: internal -> 5 pilot customers -> 50 -> GA with kill-switch.

gina: add tests: billing replay to validate accuracy, e2e clicking trace-link, telemetry for csv_download/trace_link_click/alert_fired. privacy: label numbers "estimated" and add link to billing.

prod-bot: Created ticket RD-59999: "console: obs-light MVP (cost snapshot + trace-link + CSV + webhook alpha)" assigned to @tom_k, due 2026-04-30.

infra-bot: Feature flag created: redwood.obs_light_v1. Kill-switch runbook stub created.

yvette: Decision: ship the narrow MVP. defer per-route explorer and 30d retention to v2. Action items: tom_k split RD-59999 into tasks + estimates (EOD), gina draft acceptance tests (Tue), samir coordinate pilots (Mon), infra finalize index + killswitch. demo in next product sync. :rocket:
